question: Which of the following ministries launched Phase 01 of India’s Social Protection Data Pooling Exercise in March 2025 to strengthen welfare schemes and support vulnerable groups through better data consolidation at the Central level?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Labour and Employment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Labour and Employment** launched **Phase 01** of India’s **Social Protection Data Pooling Exercise** in **March 2025**.
 
• This initiative is designed to **strengthen welfare schemes** and enhance support for **vulnerable groups** by consolidating fragmented data at the **Central level**.
 
• The primary objective of this exercise is to create a **comprehensive database** that integrates information from multiple ministries to ensure that **social security benefits** reach the intended beneficiaries without **duplication**.
 
• It builds upon the foundation of the **e-Shram portal**, which was established to register **unorganized workers**, including **migrant workers**, **construction workers**, and **gig workers**.
